comment: 30yo female with germline FLCN pathogenic variant confirmed, classic BHD triad: cutaneous fibrofolliculomas (≥10 facial + upper-trunk lesions appearing third decade) + multiple basilar/subpleural pulmonary cysts on chest CT + one prior right-sided spontaneous pneumothorax at age 27. Family history: father with bilateral chromophobe RCC at 52 + paternal grandmother with recurrent pneumothoraces. No current RCC. Engine routes to PreventionPlan: standard = q3y abdominal MRI for RCC surveillance from age 20 + dermatology consultation for skin-lesion management + pulmonology consultation re: pneumothorax-recurrence counseling (avoid SCUBA + smoking + high-pressure flying); alternative = symptom-triggered evaluation. Validates v0.2-B rare-hereditary pilot — fires RF-BHD-FAMILY-HISTORY-SUSPICION.
